title: Student/Graduate Engineer (Road Access)
content_text: Student/Graduate Engineer (Road Access) supporting Traffic and Transport Planning: assess permits, engineering designs and traffic management proposals; protect road, footpath, cycling and stormwater infrastructure. Remuneration Graduate $89,733-$101,515 + 12% super. Requires Degree in civil engineering (or related) recognised by Australian professional institute; Current NSW Class C Driver's Licence. Closing Sunday 4 October 2026 11:30PM. Eligible to work in Australia.
apply_instructions: Apply via Inner West applynow portal before 4 Oct 2026 11:30pm. Enquiries James Ogg 9392 5641.
